title: Periodic Magnetic Geodesics with Every Low Energy: Existence and Localization
summary: Let $(Q,g)$ be a Riemannian manifold equipped with a non-identically zero magnetic field represented by a closed $2$-form $β$. We allow $Q$ to be non-compact and do not assume that the metric $g$ is complete. We prove that if the magnetic strength, defined as the pointwise norm of $β$, attains a strict local maximum on a non-empty compact set $K$, then every sufficiently low energy level carries a contractible periodic magnetic geodesic of the pair $(g,β)$ localized near $K$. More precisely, such orbits exist in every neighborhood of $K$, and their lengths converge to zero with the energy.…
